flags.trigger: An associated risk state is OPEN or CONFIRMING.
A high-confidence wrong event occurred in this learning cycle.
flags.clear: Never delete history; do not display this as a current unresolved warning.

flags.trigger: At least two distinct, correct, unhinted, non-delayed decision items in the current learning cycle exceed 1.5 times expected time.
flags.clear: The active evidence window no longer contains two qualifying slow decision items.

flags.trigger: Current remediation cycle has delayed evidence but does not yet meet stable minimums and has no failed delayed attempt.
flags.clear: Cycle passes stable minimums or becomes FAILED.

flags.trigger: Any delayed decision attempt in the current remediation cycle is incorrect.
flags.clear: A new remediationCycleId begins; historical flag remains in the closed cycle.

flags.trigger: A closed, non-current remediation cycle contains an incorrect delayed attempt.
flags.clear: Never delete history; this flag does not affect the current mastery state.

flags.trigger: A decision attempt lacks valid effective or expected time.
flags.clear: Never mutate history; current report clears when its active evidence window has no missing time.

flags.trigger: A decision attempt has no confidence value.
flags.clear: Never infer a value; current report clears when its active evidence window is complete.

flags.trigger: An ability has correct hinted evidence but no unhinted decision evidence.
flags.clear: A different unhinted item supplies that ability evidence.
Event flag is retained in audit history and excluded from counts.

flags.trigger: More than one itemVersion shares the same permanent itemId in the evidence window.
flags.clear: Versions remain in history; only one independent item is counted.

flags.trigger: Legacy mm-* or exama_* data exists but current decision evidence is empty.

severity.WATCH: One high-confidence wrong attempt for the same concept and ability in a learning cycle.
severity.CRITICAL: Two or more high-confidence wrong attempts for the same concept and ability in a learning cycle.

transitions.when: One later, different, unhinted item in the same ability is correct.
A second later, different, unhinted item in the same ability is correct and at least one confirmation occurs on day 1 or later.
